method: Each source's raw fetch is content-hashed (SHA-256 of the raw response bytes, first 16 hex chars stored as source_snapshot_id). A fresh fetch from all three live sources was performed and its snapshot_ids compared against the production run's, byte-for-byte.
conclusion: No upstream revision detected in this window; all three sources returned byte-identical content. This is an honest result of a short (53-minute) window between fetches, not a claim that these sources never revise -- see docs/reproducibility.md for the mechanism that would catch a real revision, and docs/data_cards/data-card.md for each source's revision characteristics.
revision_impact_analysis: not applicable -- no revision was detected to analyze the impact of
release_materiality_threshold_defined: mean absolute score delta > 2.0 points, OR max score delta > 5.0 points, OR Spearman rank correlation < 0.98, OR any country's rank moves by more than 2 positions -- defined before this analysis ran, per this project's governance policy (docs/governance.md)
